ideas.title: SiteSense AI — Multimodal Construction Safety & Progress Copilot
ideas.problem: Site engineers spend hours manually reviewing daily site photos, WhatsApp updates, and safety checklists across packages, delaying hazard detection.
ideas.solution: Upload site photos or voice notes to Gemini 3.8 Flash multimodal AI to auto-flag PPE/housekeeping hazards, map them to zone IDs, and draft daily site inspection reports in 10 seconds.
ideas.gamudaImpact: Saves ~1.5 hrs/day per site engineer and surfaces high-risk safety issues before shift handover.

pitchDeck.verdict: Strong enterprise fit for Gamuda! To push "SiteSense AI — Multimodal Construction Safety & Progress Copilot" from 88/100 to 95+, open your demo with a real anonymized Gamuda document/photo and display a live ROI counter on screen.
blindSpots: Show how false positives are handled (human-in-the-loop approval button).
Prepare 1 offline fallback sample in case stage Wi-Fi lags during the live demo.

pitchScript.speaker: CodeKeeper (Wesley)
pitchScript.talkingPoints: Open with a relatable Gamuda site/project scenario: "Site engineers spend hours manually reviewing daily site photos, WhatsApp updates, and safety checklists across packages, delaying hazard detection." Show the 'Before' pain in 15 seconds, then introduce Team //CodeBreaker's solution: SiteSense AI — Multimodal Construction Safety & Progress Copilot.

pitchScript.talkingPoints: Run the live product (no slides!). pitchScript.speaker: CodeZero (Shaw Zhe)
pitchScript.talkingPoints: Highlight Gemini 3.8 multimodal accuracy, human-in-the-loop safety, and measurable business ROI: "Saves ~1.5 hrs/day per site engineer and surfaces high-risk safety issues before shift handover." Close with how Gamuda can pilot this next Monday.

judgeQA.question: How do you prevent AI hallucinations on critical engineering/commercial data?
judgeQA.winningAnswer: Every AI output includes source citations/confidence scores and acts as a decision copilot with 1-click engineer verification rather than blind automation.

judgeQA.question: Can this scale across existing Gamuda systems after the 48-hour hackathon?
judgeQA.winningAnswer: Yes — it is containerized for Cloud Run with a clean JSON contract (`shared/api_contract.json`), making integration with SharePoint, BIM exports, or BigQuery straightforward.

ideas.title: TenderGuard — Instant Contract & BOQ Risk Radar
ideas.problem: Reviewing 500-page tender specs and Bills of Quantities (BOQ) under tight deadlines risks missing non-standard penalty clauses or material spec mismatches.
ideas.solution: Split-screen AI reviewer that compares new tender PDFs against Gamuda historical benchmarks, highlighting high-risk clauses, cost drivers, and ambiguity questions.
ideas.gamudaImpact: Cuts first-pass tender review from 3 days to 30 minutes with traceable page citations.
